head_coach.name: Emerse Faé
head_coach.play_style_summary: Prioritizes defensive solidity and discipline, setting up in a compact mid-block with selective pressing. Relies on the individual qualities of pacy wingers for rapid counterattacks in transition.

key_players.name: Amad Diallo
key_players.performance_stats: Logged 2 goals and 3 assists in 32 Premier League appearances (2,341 minutes) for Manchester United, creating 1.87 chances per 90 with a 7.19 FotMob rating. Scored the match-winning goal in a recent June 2026 friendly against France.

key_players.name: Ousmane Diomande
key_players.performance_stats: Started 37 matches across all competitions for Sporting CP, maintaining a 91.7% pass completion rate, 7.25 average FotMob rating, and contributing to 17 clean sheets.

key_players.name: Simon Adingra
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded 3 goals and 2 assists in 14 Ligue 1 appearances (861 minutes) for AS Monaco, averaging 1.4 chances created per 90 and maintaining a 7.16 FotMob rating.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Withdrawn from the World Cup squad due to an adductor injury suffered in club training with AJ Auxerre.
Suffered a second-degree hamstring lesion with AS Roma, leaving him highly doubtful for the start of the World Cup.
